term.label: mitochondrial_D_loop

definition.text: Mitochondrial displacement loop; a region within mitochondrial DNA in which a short stretch of RNA is paired with one strand of DNA, displacing the original partner DNA strand in this region.

comments: Added as per request by Terence Murphy (INSDC) for GitHub Issue #417 (https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/417)
